summary: Frontend UI testing for CavernicolApp Mobile (Expo Web preview). rca_of_issue: React-Native-Web's ResponderSystem (used by PanResponder) subscribes via `useResponderEvents` and gates event handling through the React Native event system. Synthetic DOM events dispatched via `element.dispatchEvent(...)` are marked `isTrusted=false` and are effectively ignored/short-circuited by the responder implementation on this react-native-web build (also common with React's `nativeEvent` filtering). CDP `Input.dispatchTouchEvent` normally emits trusted events, but the Playwright context here is launched without `hasTouch=true`, so the ResponderSystem's pointer/touch pipeline may still not engage the pan gesture path. Real browsers with real user input work fine; the fix on the testability side is to add a web-only tappable fallback or an in-mock-mode dev hook to trigger `useAuthStore.login`.
